idea.what: Imagine Palus, a managed reserve portfolio.
idea.how: A treasury account links to your existing bank through Plaid. It holds your long-term reserve in a managed portfolio of short-duration, floating-rate, government-backed mortgage bonds. Assets sit in your company's name at a regulated custodian. Cash is back in checking in one to two business days.
idea.belief: The people building it believe it would reach its target of 4.5 to 5 percent on your long-term reserve.
